item.title: Sven — Creator
item.content:
Artist, student without web fundamentals

Sven is a student studying to be an artist. He has to focus on his craft and doesn't have time to manage web properties. For people to see his work, he needs a basic website. He's been burned in the past by companies that hosted his material going out of business. HAX drag-and-drop tools and portable format allow him to easily create new spaces for his art without vendor reliance.

Where to start

You don't need any web background to use HAX. These areas are the gentlest on-ramp:

  • Editing & Authoring — edit a page and add blocks by dragging, no code required.
  • Working with Media — show off your work with images and video.
  • Using HAX For… — concept recipes for portfolios, club sites, and more.

Because HAX content is portable, you own your site and can move it anywhere. See Troubleshooting & FAQ if you get stuck.
